default.notes: Apply for the official eVisa (evisa.gouv.cd) — geared to arrivals at Kinshasa N'djili airport — or obtain a visa from a DRC embassy before travel; a 'visa volant' on arrival is possible only with prior DGM authorisation arranged by a sponsor.

groups.notes: Reported as visa-exempt for short stays under bilateral or regional arrangements — commonly cited as up to 90 days, but application at DRC borders is inconsistent; confirm with the DGM or an embassy before travel.

The DRC is an East African Community member and visa facilitation for EAC citizens is being phased in — until it is uniformly applied, apply for the eVisa or an embassy visa, and confirm current treatment with the DGM.

CD.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Congolese (DRC) citizens.
